test_QiuDisturbance: test the QiuDisturbance class to verify its asset_name and im property trigger Earth Engine calls
test_Sentinel2_asset: test the Sentinel2 class with L2A or L1C mode to verify correct asset_name and ImageCollection access
run_Sentinel2_stack: run Sentinel2.stack on a dict of band arrays to stack them into a 3D numpy array
run_Sentinel2_stack_vis: run Sentinel2.stack with vis=True to stack only the visible RGB bands into a 3-channel array
run_Sentinel2_vis: run Sentinel2.vis on a dict of band arrays to extract and normalize RGB values to 0-1 range
